name: All haul the king
storyline:
In this online 1-4 player co-op journey it is all up to you, his loyal servants, to drag the king’s giant floppy corpse to the Throne of Resurrection.

The throne is on the other side of the kingdom though! And the kingdom is filled with puzzles and really inconvenient obstacles! Laugh, cry and shout your way through these together, as a team.

The king might be dead, but his gut is not. Feed the king whatever you find. Stars, flowers, animals, your friend that you shrunk down. He'll eat it all and his body will react in different ways. Find use for it. Harness it. But maybe keep your distance. Just to be safe.

Your goblin magic can be a real game changer sometimes. Literally. Try using it on different things to see how it can help you on your journey.
summary: A co-op game where you and your friends embark on an epic journey to drag the goblin king’s dead body across the kingdom to resurrect him. Use brains, brawn and crazy goblin magic to navigate the tricky terrain and puzzles that lie in your path.
